text:
Registration of the marriage abroad is not required to begin the process nor to end the process. The protocol states that people who did not register the marriage will have to present an additional certificate of personal status at the end of the process, and as this certificate can show they are single/windowed/divorced , it's just to show they are not married to another. This is explained on our website. 

However, it is true that some PIBA offices or specific clerks are misinterpreting the procedure and applying it wrong. In those cases, an appeal may be necessary to get your rights.

In case someone does not believe me personally, I have discussed this topic recently with a few colleague attorneys which are all agreeing about the correct interpretation of the procedure. I am aware of a couple of appeals that are currently underway on this subject (but still no resolution).
